info.name: Lendis Content API (WordPress REST) case-study discovery API
Get the wp/v2 namespace route index

items.docs: Returns the machine-readable route index for the `wp/v2` namespace: every route, its supported methods and argument schemas. This is the discovery document this OpenAPI was derived from.
Returns every post type registered on the Lendis site, keyed by type name, including its `rest_base` and associated taxonomies.
Returns every taxonomy registered on the Lendis site, keyed by taxonomy name.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit the result set to objects with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Limit the response to a comma-separated list of fields.

params.name: _embed
params.description: Embed linked resources (author, featured media, terms) into the response.

items.docs: Full-text search across the Lendis site's searchable content types, returning lightweight result stubs carrying id, title, url, type and subtype.
